tasks.instruction: Implement UI and browser verification for lead's connected renderer antialias work. Allowed files ONLY app/connected-global-preview.js, tools/connected-global-preview.html, docs/qa/claude-pixel-sampling.md. Renderer draw/read/readColor gain antialias boolean (default false). Global UI should offer checked Smooth edges toggle passing antialias true; diagnostics stays unsmoothed center rays regardless toggle. Shader samples four quarter-pixel positions (2x2), averages in gamma2-linear space: sqrt(mean(color^2)). If ANY sample is numerical unresolved, whole display pixel stays magenta; domain pattern can average. Debug read always center, byte-identical regardless toggle. No query changes or derivative calls. Add actual checkbox checks, debug invariance, and a 2x-resolution independent same-pose reference: for pixels whose four high-resolution diagnostic rays all HIT, low-resolution AA color must equal sqrt(mean(four high-resolution NON-AA colors squared)) within 2/255 per channel (quantization), require meaningful eligible pixels and visible difference vs center-only sampling. Save before/after screenshots at same view (prefer near a sphere with clear silhouette); do not change existing tests/thresholds. Collect separate GPU timing distributions for antialias false/true at same pose/resolution, not pooled, include hardware/resolution. No full suite, no browser or queue from clone: lead runs integrated tree. No commits/pushes/agents. Report under 400 words, explicitly unrun renderer-dependent checks. Keep tests independent of lead implementation and report blockers.
